full_prompt_en: A square high-contrast black-and-white photograph frames a young woman from the shoulders upward amid a nearly black crowd or interior. She is positioned a little right of center and turns her face toward the left, showing a delicate three-quarter profile. Her dark hair falls straight around the cheeks and is partly hidden under a broad, shadowy hood or dark head covering. The visible eye looks past the left edge with a distant, reflective expression. Her nose and lips are softly lit, while her chin and neck fade into the dark clothing below. At the far left, another person's face appears only as a partial profile, mostly in shadow and cropped by the frame. Behind the main subject, pale fragments of wall or light make a rough, irregular backdrop, but no precise location is described. Fine scratches, dust specks, and irregular white marks are visible across the image, especially near the black edges and upper corners. This distressed surface gives the print an aged, handled quality. Illumination is soft but directional enough to lift the main face out of the surrounding dark. White skin tones are bright without becoming smooth or glossy; hair, clothes, and outer space merge into deep blacks. The camera is close, with very little depth between foreground and background. The main face forms a calm light shape set against several overlapping dark shapes, and the sliver of second face keeps the frame from feeling isolated. The overall image is intimate, grainy, and emotionally restrained, using abrupt crop and print wear as part of its visual language.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、高反差黑白照片在近乎黑色的人群或室内空间中框住一名年轻女子的肩部以上。她位于中央略右，面孔向左转，呈细腻的四分之三侧面。深发直直垂在脸颊旁，部分藏在宽阔暗影般的兜帽或深色头巾下。可见的一只眼睛望向左侧画外，表情遥远而沉静。鼻子与嘴唇受到柔光照亮，下巴和颈部则退入下方暗衣。最左边，另一人的脸仅显出被画框截断、几乎在阴影中的局部侧影。主角身后，浅色墙面或光斑碎片组成粗糙、不规则背景，但具体地点无法辨认。图像上可见细划痕、灰尘点和不规则白痕，尤其在黑色边缘及上方角落。这种磨损表面让照片有经年把玩的老印相气质。照明柔和，却有足够方向性把主面孔从周围暗处托出。浅色肤调明亮，却不光滑发亮；头发、衣服和外侧空间融入深黑。相机距离很近，前后景之间几乎没有纵深。主要面孔是重叠暗形之间一块平静的亮色，另一张脸的窄窄残影令画面不显孤立。整幅图亲密、有颗粒、情绪克制，以突然裁切和相纸磨损作为视觉语言的一部分。
style_prompt_en: High-contrast black-and-white photography lets soft skin tones emerge from merged black hair, clothing, and background. Tight cropping, overlapping partial forms, and shallow spatial cues create closeness. Keep natural facial texture and a reflective eye, while reducing surrounding detail to dark masses and a few pale fragments. Visible grain, scratches, dust, and uneven print marks add a worn analog surface. Light is soft and localized, not a broad studio wash; highlights remain matte and shadows retain depth. The mood is quiet, raw, and immediate, with composition shaped by abrupt edges as much as by the focal form.
style_prompt_zh: 高反差黑白摄影让柔和肤色从互相融并的黑发、衣物和背景中浮现。紧密裁切、重叠的局部形体与浅弱的空间线索制造亲近感。保留自然面部质地和沉静目光，周围细节则化为暗色块与少数浅色碎片。可见颗粒、划痕、灰点和不均匀印相痕迹增添磨旧胶片表面。光线柔和且局部化，不是宽泛的影棚漫洗；高光保持哑光，阴影保有深度。情绪安静、粗粝而直接，构图同时由突然的边缘和焦点形体塑造。
theme_en: A young woman in a dark hood looking left beside another partial face
theme_zh: 深色头巾中的年轻女子向左望，旁边露出另一张局部面孔
name: Jacob Aue Sobol
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
